move: pink ball drops and bounces with squash, seams draw on, spins, bounces out
how: A pink circle SVG with three curved seam strokes, a blurred shadow ellipse, and a caption clipped to one line. 0-27%: the ball falls from y -420 with rotation -200 under bounce.out, squashing to scaleY .82/scaleX 1.14 at 14% (0.1s yoyo from the bottom origin) as it lands; the shadow grows from scaleX .2 with the same bounce. At 18% the seams drawSVG 0->100% with a 0.12s stagger (power2.out), then the ball eases to rotation 20 over 1.2s (sine.inOut). At 33% 'New shot posted' slides up from yPercent 120 (expo.out). Exit at 78-83%: a quick anticipation squash, then the ball launches to y -500 rotating 120 (power3.in) while the shadow shrinks and the caption slides up out.
adapt: Swap the caption string, the Dribbble pink (#ea4c89) and the seam paths for the product's mark or any round logo; keep the bounce.out drop, the 0.1s landing squash and the 0.12s seam stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the ball SVG, shadow and caption inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with positions as fractions of D (drop 0-0.27D, seams at 0.18D, text at 0.33D, exit at 0.78D). Register DrawSVGPlugin; scope selectors to el; the y -420/-500 offsets assume a 720px-tall frame and should be derived from el height. from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
ends with the ball off-frame rather than returning to frame one
shadow uses filter: blur(6px), cheap at this size
